verdict.rationale: Kit has a documented V4 REST API, but the evidence pack never mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and a probe of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404 on every one. The llms.txt index and the Developer Docs MCP give agents access to the documentation, but neither is a machine-readable API specification, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
